message.content: {"candidate_id": "pair_758dc3dc309ce5ca", "label": "complementary", "right_from_left": [1, 0], "rationale": "The predicates `owned_by` and `has` describe different relationships between entities. `owned_by` indicates ownership (a person or organization *owns* an item), while `has` indicates possession (an entity *has* an item). The `WOE` actions demonstrate this distinction: `spend_money_on_drink` describes a transfer of money from an employer to an employee, while `take_gold_pot_and_hide` describes an employee taking an item. The different preconditions and effects of the actions reinforce that these predicates represent distinct relationships.
